formulas.shield: round(card shield base × rarity) + SP × cost
formulas.heal: round(card heal base × rarity) + H × cost
formulas.energy: 2 + inherited E + scheduled growth, plus at most 3 temporary energy bonus
formulas.synergySupport: round(fixed card effect base + 0.5 × SP/H × cost)
formulas.intervals: AP/SP/H base 5, energy base 10; reciprocal element/role/individual trades; bounded 3–7 and 8–12

limits: Deterministic progression and effect audit, not a win-rate simulation.
